answer: Graders are drawn at random from a kernel-sharded web, cross-verified by plume-aligned auditors. If receipts mismatch after reef surveys, both downvote and lose stake. Sybils must repay all loans plus a 10% fee per clone, as shared signatures invalidate consensus. Honest agents reuse kernels cheaply, but each fake must re-route credit, costing O(1) per ID with no parallelism.
